specs.title: UI-PREF-003 time display uses the selected clock mode

annotations.description: Actual current React with controlled login/validation/activity renewal and seeded empty workspace. Preference storage is real browser storage. Clock cases use Playwright clock.

steps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as fixture UI-USER-01 with the case-specific permissions
2. And the controlled time is 2026-10-22T00:05:00Z and browser timezone is Asia/Singapore; clock mode is UTC
3. When User A clicks switch named "Time Switch" inside the shell application bar
4. Then text with text "08:05 Local" inside the Time Switch fieldset in the shell application bar is visible
5. And switch named "Time Switch" inside the shell application bar is not checked
